install=meta.get('install',{})
assert install.get('action')=='save_response_body'
target=Path(install['path']).resolve()
app=Path('/workspace/app').resolve()
assert target.parent == app, f'unsafe target {target}'
target.write_bytes(body)
cfg['version']=version
cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps(cfg,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'Saved {len(body)} bytes to {target}')
print(f'Updated {cfg_path} to {version}')
